summary: Upgraded the ClientApp from Angular 16.2 to Angular 17.3 with `ng update @angular/core@17 @angular/cli@17`, which also moved TypeScript to 5.4 and zone.js to 0.14, and bumped @ngrx/* from 16 to 17 to match the new Angular peer range. The CLI migration renamed `browserTarget` to `buildTarget` in angular.json, and the NgRx migration added the now-required `connectInZone: true` to StoreDevtoolsModule.instrument(). No hand-written source fixes were needed beyond reformatting that injected option; `npm install`, `npm run build` and `npm run build:ssr` pass, and `npm run test` still fails for the same pre-existing reason as at baseline.
changes: angular.json: `browserTarget` renamed to `buildTarget` for the serve and extract-i18n targets (CLI migration for the deprecated option).
src/app/app.module.ts: StoreDevtoolsModule.instrument() now passes `connectInZone: true`, added by the NgRx v17 migration; only reindented by hand.
manual_followups: Tests still fail exactly as at baseline: the `test` target in angular.json lists the stylesheet as "styles.css" instead of "src/styles.css", so Karma aborts with "Can't resolve 'styles.css'" before running any spec. Fixing that one path would let the suite run.
rxjs is still ^6.6.7. Angular 17 accepts it, but Angular 18 requires rxjs 6.5.3+/7.4+ and the ecosystem has moved to 7.x, so schedule the rxjs 7 bump in an upcoming hop.

The app is still fully NgModule-based and uses the deprecated `@angular-devkit/build-angular:browser` builder plus the aspnet-prerendering SSR setup; moving to the application builder / standalone APIs will be needed before the later hops.
Deprecated/legacy devDeps remain (tslint, codelyzer, protractor, node-sass, core-js 2, @types/node 12); they are unused by the required checks but should be retired.
